finding.quote: Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, PivX hereby grants to Detto a non-transferable, exclusive license to distribute PivX's Qwik-Fix Pro and any documentation supporting Qwik-Fix Pro provided from time to time by PivX (the "Documentation") within North America, solely to third parties to whom Detto licenses Qwik-Fix Pro ("Third Parties"), and as governed by the terms set forth in Exhibit A (PivX/Detto Reseller Agreement Addendum).
finding.note: PivX grants Detto an exclusive license to distribute Qwik-Fix Pro within North America without carve-outs or exceptions in the provided text.

finding.quote: Neither Newegg nor Allied shall have the right or power to assign or transfer any part of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior consent in writing of the other Party.
finding.overrideQuote: The parties acknowledge that the transfer of this Agreement to a successor entity in connection with a merger, consolidation, or the sale of all or substantially all of the assets or equity of a party constitutes a continuation of the existing contractual relationship and not an assignment, transfer or delegation for the purposes of this Agreement. The consent requirements set out in this Agreement have no application to any such transaction, and no notice to the other party is required in respect of it.
finding.note: Section 15.4 prohibits assignment or transfer without prior written consent, but the Corporate Reorganisations clause carves out transfers in connection with a merger, consolidation, or sale of assets/equity from requiring consent or notice.
The contract does not contain a standard change of control provision granting specific rights or remedies upon a change of ownership or control.

finding.quote: Allied shall not endorse, or permit the marketing of any other company whose principal business is as an e-commerce provider at or in connection with the Arena.

The continuation, renewal or expansion of any such arrangement by either party is permitted and shall not constitute a breach of this Agreement.
finding.note: Section 7.2 grants exclusivity prohibiting Allied from endorsing or permitting marketing of competing e-commerce providers, but the Pre-existing Arrangements clause exempts pre-existing relationships from exclusivity restrictions.

finding.quote: This Agreement and all rights and duties hereunder are personal to Diplomat and shall not, without the written consent of KI, Inc., be assigned, mortgaged, sublicensed or otherwise encumbered by Diplomat or by operation of law.
finding.overrideQuote: KI, Inc. may assign its rights hereunder, but shall furnish written notice of such assignment to Diplomat.
finding.note: Diplomat is prohibited from assigning or encumbering the agreement without the prior written consent of KI, Inc., while KI, Inc. is expressly permitted to assign its rights upon written notice.
The agreement contains no change of control provisions.

finding.quote: The license hereby granted shall be exclusive as to the products described in subparagraphs 2.(a)(1) and (2) of this Agreement, but nonexclusive as to all other products covered by this Agreement.
finding.overrideQuote: Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to prevent KI, Inc. from granting any other licenses for the use of KI's name or likeness, or from utilizing KI's name and likeness in any manner whatsoever, except that KI, Inc. agrees that except as provided herein it will grant no other licenses for the territory to which this license extends for the use of KI's name and likeness in connection with the sale of the products described in subparagraphs 2.(a)(1) and (2) of this Agreement effective during the term of this Agreement.
finding.note: The grant of exclusivity is limited specifically to certain product categories (sunglasses, ophthalmic frames, and specific accessories sold in optical retailers) and is nonexclusive as to other products.

finding.quote: Except as expressly provided for herein, neither party may assign or otherwise transfer any of its rights or obligations under this  Agreement without the other party's prior written approval and any such assignment or transfer shall be void.
finding.overrideQuote: Corporate Reorganisations. The parties acknowledge that the transfer of this Agreement to a successor entity in connection with a merger, consolidation, or the sale of all or substantially all of the assets or equity of a party constitutes a continuation of the existing contractual relationship and not an assignment, transfer or delegation for the purposes of this Agreement. The consent requirements set out in this Agreement have no application to any such transaction, and no notice to the other party is required in respect of it.
finding.note: Section 8.5 restricts assignments without prior written approval, but the Corporate Reorganisations clause creates an exception for transfers to successor entities in connection with mergers, consolidations, or sales of substantially all assets or equity.

finding.quote: (a) At the election of either party, in writing, if: (i) all or substantially all of the assets of the non-terminating party are transferred, sold or  liquidated; (ii) the non-terminating party is dissolved; (iii) the non-terminating party is adjudged a bankrupt or becomes insolvent;  (iv) the non-terminating party enters into an assignment or other arrangement for the benefit of its creditors; or (v) the ownership or  operations of the non-terminating party have materially changed;
finding.note: Section 7.2(a) permits either party to terminate the agreement if the ownership or operations of the other party have materially changed, or if all or substantially all assets are transferred, sold, or liquidated.

finding.quote: Pursuant to the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement, Aura appoints Zanotti as its exclusive supplier of the Products  within the Territory and Field of Use and Zanotti hereby accepts such appointment.

finding.quote: The License Rights are exclusive to Berkshire and may not be assigned or in any way conveyed by Berkshire without Auriemma's  express written consent, except in the event of a merger by Berkshire with another entity offering Banking Services.
finding.overrideQuote: except in the event of a merger by Berkshire with another entity offering Banking Services.
finding.note: While assignments by Berkshire generally require written consent, Section 2(c) permits assignment of License Rights without consent in the event of a merger with another entity offering Banking Services, and Section 22 permits Auriemma to assign monetary benefits.

finding.quote: Continuity of Ownership. For the purposes of this Agreement, a transaction in which the ultimate beneficial ownership of a party remains substantially unchanged, including any internal reorganisation, recapitalisation, or transaction effected solely to alter the jurisdiction of incorporation of that party, does not constitute a change of control, an acquisition, or a transfer of control of that party. The rights and obligations arising under this Agreement upon a change of control have no application to any such transaction.
finding.overrideQuote: a transaction in which the ultimate beneficial ownership of a party remains substantially unchanged, including any internal reorganisation, recapitalisation, or transaction effected solely to alter the jurisdiction of incorporation of that party, does not constitute a change of control, an acquisition, or a transfer of control of that party.
finding.note: The contract provides that change of control provisions do not apply to internal reorganisations, recapitalisations, or transactions where ultimate beneficial ownership remains substantially unchanged.

finding.quote: Auriemma will not enter into any arrangement or agreement, which enables any Berkshire Competitor to be endorsed by Auriemma  (whether by using the Auriemma Identification, Auriemma providing services similar to the Endorsement Services, or otherwise) during the  Contract Period within the Contract Territory.

finding.note: Auriemma agrees to exclusivity preventing endorsement of competitors, but the clause expressly qualifies this by acknowledging Auriemma has no control over decisions by the University of Connecticut to contract with competitors.
